label: Cut nets in a bipartition
subgoals: Assign every cell to one side
Mark a net cut when its pins fall on both sides
Count each cut net once regardless of how many pins cross

label: Weighted cuts
subgoals: Attach a weight to each net
Sum the weights of the cut nets
Merge identical nets by summing weights to keep cuts exact

label: Cut metrics for k-way partitions
subgoals: Count the blocks each net touches
Charge lambda minus 1 per net for the connectivity metric
Compare with the cut-net count, which charges 1 per cut net
